Pricing

What determines water heater repair & installation cost?

This is not a price book. It lists the cost drivers so any water heater quote can be read and compared on the same basis.

1 Gas tank replacement, 40-50 galVenting route, gas line size, whether the flue is shared with the furnace. Permit usually required.
2 Power-vent or direct-vent conversionSidewall penetration, condensate route, electrical outlet at the unit. Permit usually required.
3 Tankless conversionGas line upsizing is the real cost, not the appliance. Permit usually required.
4 No hot water - repairThermocouple, gas valve, igniter or element. Diagnosis first, parts second. Usually no permit.
5 Draught and venting correctionShared masonry flue, spillage at the draft hood, liner condition. Depends on scope.

Equipment and configurations

Water Heater Repair & Installation by configuration

Chicago basements hold a narrower range than the catalogues suggest. These eight are common configurations, and the flue arrangement matters more than the brand.

Atmospheric-vent gas tank

Drafts up an existing chimney. Common in Chicago basements

Power-vent gas tank

Fan-assisted, vents out a sidewall when no flue is available

Direct-vent gas tank

Sealed combustion, draws its own air from outside

Electric tank

No flue, no gas. Common in condos and converted units

Tankless gas

Wall-hung, continuous hot water within its rated flow; cold winter inlet water and several taps at once reduce output, and gas and venting often need upsizing

Indirect cylinder

Heated by a boiler. Can suit hot-water and some steam homes when boiler output and controls are compatible

Combi boiler

Heat and hot water from one wall unit, no cylinder

Expansion tank & venting

Code-related parts an inspector may check; a good replacement quote states whether they are included

Equipment names we see

These names are examples of equipment found in Chicago homes. They are not dealer affiliations. A good proposal sizes the heater to the flue, gas line and household demand rather than to a brand.

Water heater work can involve more than one trade

A tank swap disturbs the shared flue, the gas line and the furnace draft. A good quote states which contractor handles the venting, the gas connection and the plumbing, and who pulls any required permit.

Before the visit

The type you have is usually decided by your flue, not your preference. In homes with a hot-water or steam boiler, an indirect cylinder can be an option, depending on boiler output, controls and the household's hot-water demand.

Water Heater Repair & Installation questions

My water heater is leaking. Do I actually need a new one?

A leak from the tank itself generally means replacement, because a tank leak is not repairable. A drip from a fitting or the drain valve is usually a part. Water from the temperature and pressure relief valve is different: it can signal excess pressure, thermal expansion or overheating, so the valve and its discharge pipe should be kept clear, never capped or plugged, and the cause diagnosed by a professional. A good replacement quote names the failure point in writing. For a gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm, leave the building and call 911 or the gas utility from outside.

Does City & Suburban replace the water heater itself, or only the heating side?

That depends on the job, so it is worth confirming with City & Suburban at (773) 238-3838 before booking. Plumbing, gas and venting work on a water heater may fall to different trades, and a good quote states which contractor handles each part and who pulls any required permit.

Does a water heater replacement need a permit in Chicago?

Usually. A full replacement typically needs a permit in Chicago, while repairs and part swaps generally do not; the exact requirement depends on the scope and the municipality. Chicago's permit records show 445 permits mentioning water heater work in the 24 months to August 2026. A replacement quote should state who pulls any required permit.

Is tankless worth it in a Chicago two-flat?

Often not, and the reason is the gas line rather than the appliance. Tankless draws far more gas at peak, so the line back to the meter usually has to be upsized - and in a masonry two-flat that run is the expensive part. A gas line assessment belongs in the quote before appliance prices are compared.

How fast can City & Suburban come out if there is no hot water?

City & Suburban offers same-day service when the schedule allows. Calling (773) 238-3838 is the way to check whether a water heater job fits the current schedule and service scope. A gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm is different: leave the building and call 911 or the gas utility from outside.

City & Suburban serves 21 areas: 13 Chicago neighborhoods and 8 suburbs. Each area appears in the service areas list above, with a link to its local page. For an address outside those 21 areas, call (773) 238-3838 to check whether a visit is possible.

sections.html:
Water Heater Repair & Installation questions

My water heater is leaking. Do I actually need a new one?

A leak from the tank itself generally means replacement, because a tank leak is not repairable. A drip from a fitting or the drain valve is usually a part. Water from the temperature and pressure relief valve is different: it can signal excess pressure, thermal expansion or overheating, so the valve and its discharge pipe should be kept clear, never capped or plugged, and the cause diagnosed by a professional. A good replacement quote names the failure point in writing. For a gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm, leave the building and call 911 or the gas utility from outside.

Does City & Suburban replace the water heater itself, or only the heating side?

That depends on the job, so it is worth confirming with City & Suburban at (773) 238-3838 before booking. Plumbing, gas and venting work on a water heater may fall to different trades, and a good quote states which contractor handles each part and who pulls any required permit.

Does a water heater replacement need a permit in Chicago?

Usually. A full replacement typically needs a permit in Chicago, while repairs and part swaps generally do not; the exact requirement depends on the scope and the municipality. Chicago's permit records show 445 permits mentioning water heater work in the 24 months to August 2026. A replacement quote should state who pulls any required permit.

Is tankless worth it in a Chicago two-flat?

Often not, and the reason is the gas line rather than the appliance. Tankless draws far more gas at peak, so the line back to the meter usually has to be upsized - and in a masonry two-flat that run is the expensive part. A gas line assessment belongs in the quote before appliance prices are compared.

How fast can City & Suburban come out if there is no hot water?

City & Suburban offers same-day service when the schedule allows. Calling (773) 238-3838 is the way to check whether a water heater job fits the current schedule and service scope. A gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm is different: leave the building and call 911 or the gas utility from outside.
